versions.author: Boris Delange
versions.message: Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26). 738 -> 817 concepts. Added 79 (new or reclassified descendants in the new release): E. coli O103:H19 (37464316); Escherichia coli serotype O187:H52 (37464317); Shiga toxin-producting Escherichia coli serotype O187 (37464318); Escherichia coli serotype O187 (37464319); Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli serotype O187:H52 (37464320); and 74 more. 2 concept names updated by the vocabulary (e.g. 'Multiple drug-resistant Escherichia coli' -> 'Multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli').
